name: Cluster Heart

stealth.details: (master) to hear or feel the energy coalescing

disable: DC 45 Nature check (master) to chip away at the crystal and disrupt its resonance, or DC 42 Thievery check (master) to carefully detach the crystals and then safely smash them
reset: Once the cluster heart uses its reaction, it automatically resets after 1 minute. As long as the cluster heart has 150 or more Hit Points, it recovers 50 per day.

items.name: Resistance to Disintegrate
items.text: Disintegrate deals double damage, ignoring Hardness, rather than destroying the cluster heart outright

items.name: Crystal Surge
items.text:
Trigger A non-elemental creature ends its turn adjacent to the cluster heart

---

Effect The heart extends shards of crystal imbued with force, like a jabbing blade, and deals 3d10+20 force,3d10+20 piercing damage to all creatures in a 20-foot radius (DC 40 basic Reflex save save). A creature who takes piercing damage from the surge is exposed to crystal corruption. On a critical failure, a creature also takes 2d6 persistent,bleed damage.

items.name: Crystalline Corruption
items.text:
Creatures afflicted by this curse slowly turn to solid crystal. This affliction's sickened, slowed, and paralyzed conditions can't be removed until the affliction itself is removed. Creatures with both the earth and elemental traits instead become carriers and suffer no ill effects aside from gaining the weakness to sonic.

Saving Throw DC 40 Fortitude save

Stage 1 sickened 1 (1 hour)

Stage 2 weakness 5 to sonic and Sickened 1 (1 day)

Stage 3 weakness 5 to sonic and Slowed 1 (1 day)

Stage 4 weakness 10 to sonic and Paralyzed (1 day)

Stage 5 weakness 10 to sonic, and the creature is permanently Petrified.

text: A wave of magic passes through the area, causing crystal shards to grow and stab intruders.
